ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Minnesota Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program and the state's Medicaid funding, including the Trump administration's role in the scandal.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the connections between state and federal agencies
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program?
How is the Trump administration involved in the scandal?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread corruption and abuse of power at the state and federal levels. By following the money and examining the connections between state and federal agencies, we may be able to expose a larger scheme and bring those responsible to justice.
